title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.
tldr: Endo-TSR augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier color residuals and translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies, plus a Matérn spectral prior and multi-scale Laplacian supervision, achieving state-of-the-art endoscopic scene reconstruction on EndoNeRF and StereoMIS.
tldr_zh: Endo-TSR 在可变形高斯溅射中引入有界傅里叶颜色残差和共享时间频率上的平移残差，并结合 Matérn 谱先验与多尺度拉普拉斯监督，在 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 上实现了最先进的内窥镜场景重建质量。
summary_zh: 内窥镜场景重建需要在恢复精细表面细节的同时，对组织运动和时序外观进行建模。可变形高斯模型提供了显式轨迹，但其固定的颜色系数缺乏对光度变化的专用时序表示。我们提出 Endo-TSR，该方法在共享时序频率上，用有界傅里叶颜色残差和独立的平移残差来增强可变形高斯溅射。颜色残差捕获局部外观变化，而 Matérn 谱先验对运动校正进行正则化。多尺度拉普拉斯监督在联合图像拟合过程中引导组织细节恢复。在 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 数据集上的大量实验证明了最先进的渲染质量，在所有评估序列中取得了最高的 PSNR。消融研究表明，在所测试的组件添加中，时序外观带来了最大的 PSNR 提升，而外观和细节监督在固定高斯数量下共同改善了渲染效果。

title: A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases
summary: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.
tldr: This paper presents a bilingual AI audiologist that combines a large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation, and retrieval-augmented grounding—without fine-tuning the backbone—and shows it outperforms human audiologists on simulated clinical cases, with ablations indicating the induced playbook is the key contributor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双语AI听力学家系统，结合大语言模型、基于评分量规的诊疗策略归纳、多模态听力图解读与检索增强 grounding，且不微调底层模型；在模拟病例评估中全面超越人类听力学家，消融实验表明归纳出的策略库是主要贡献来源。
summary_zh: 听力学科咨询需要结构化的病史采集、听力图解读和以患者为中心的沟通，然而现实世界中的病例材料十分稀缺。我们提出了一种双语AI听力学家系统，将通用大语言模型与基于评分标准的策略归纳、多模态听力图解读以及检索增强 grounding 相结合，且无需对语言模型主干进行微调。我们利用一项包含21个条目的评分标准和一个AI患者模拟器，从73个训练病例（43个英文，30个中文）中归纳出一套包含19条规则的咨询策略，并在预先指定、来源盲法的比较中，使用58个独立模拟病例（30个中文，28个英文）对系统进行了评估，与17名执业听力学家进行对比。该AI听力学家在每一个病例（58/58；5分制综合评分的平均配对差值为 +1.35，Cohen's d = 1.84，P = 4.5 × 10⁻²⁰）以及21个评分条目中的20个、两种语言中均优于人类听力学家。组件消融实验表明，策略归纳是贡献最大的部分，为低数据医疗领域中构建专科咨询智能体提供了一条实用路径。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.
tldr: AnesTRACE is a benchmark and evaluation suite for intraoperative anesthesia AI, testing perception, single-step decision-making, and multi-step decision-making with an anesthesiologist-aligned evaluator. Results across 30 models reveal significant gaps in visual grounding, safety, and latency, showing that aggregate performance alone is insufficient for safe longitudinal anesthesia decisions.
tldr_zh: AnesTRACE 是一个面向术中麻醉的基准测试与评估套件，涵盖感知、单步决策和多步决策，并使用与麻醉医生对齐的评估器。对30多个模型的评测显示其在视觉定位、安全性和延迟方面仍存在明显不足，说明仅靠总体性能无法保证安全、及时的纵向决策。
summary_zh:
摘要：
术中麻醉需要系统能够解读不断演变的多模态证据、推荐及时的管理措施，并随着患者状态变化而调整决策，然而现有基准通常将感知或单点推理割裂开来。我们提出了AnesTRACE，一个包含AnesTRACE-Bench和AnesTRACE-Eval的评估套件。AnesTRACE-Bench基于公开的围术期数据集并经麻醉科医生标注，用于评估术中感知、单点麻醉决策和多步麻醉决策。AnesTRACE-Eval通过麻醉科医生定义的临床正确性、证据依据、任务完整性和安全性标准对开放式回答进行评估，并对多步决策引入时间一致性；其领域特定评估器通过监督微调和偏好对齐在专家评审判断上进行训练。在超过30个模型的测试中，细粒度视觉定位和干预选择仍然困难：领先模型在TEE视觉定位上仅达到32.2 mIoU，并且在多步管理中仍有17.5%的重大/关键安全错误率。评估器与麻醉科医生的一致性在两个训练阶段均有所提升，而最佳决策质量伴随74.3秒的P95延迟。这些结果表明，仅凭总体性能并不能确保证安全、及时的纵向决策。我们在https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE 发布了代码。

title: Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support
summary: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.
tldr: This paper proposes a response-aware patient dynamics model for ICU respiratory support that explicitly models physiological change by decomposing it into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, using room air as a reference. Evaluated on two independent ICU cohorts, it achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction with more consistent improvements during periods of physiological change.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种反应感知的患者动态模型，用于ICU呼吸支持场景，显式建模生理变化，将预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动态和呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气作为参考。在两个独立ICU队列上的评估显示，总体轨迹预测与基线相当，在生理状态变化期间有更一致的改进。
summary_zh:
摘要：
呼吸支持可塑造危重症患者的短期生理轨迹，但接受相同干预的患者可能遵循不同的生理轨迹。临床患者动力学模型通常根据近期生理状态和记录的干预措施预测未来状态，而生理变化主要通过预测的未来状态来体现。我们提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，该模型在自回归状态更新过程中显式地表示生理变化。该模型将预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动力学和呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气作为分解的参照。我们对该参照锚定公式进行了形式化分析。一条响应路径编码预测的生理变化，并利用其在预测时间范围内更新潜在患者状态。在两个独立机构的ICU队列中，所提出的模型在整体轨迹预测上与患者动力学基线方法相当，且在生理状态发生变化时具有更一致的改进。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.
tldr: MedCode trains LLMs to generate executable code for medical calculations, delegating arithmetic to a deterministic interpreter, and uses weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO) to improve accuracy by 20-30 percentage points across several 7B-scale LLMs.
tldr_zh: MedCode 通过训练大模型生成可执行代码，将医疗计算中的算术运算交给确定性解释器，并引入加权直接偏好优化（wDPO）；在多个7B模型上准确率提升20-30个百分点。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医学考试和问答基准测试中表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医学计算任务上仍不可靠。这些计算支撑着药物剂量、器官功能评估和预后评分等高风险的临床决策，即使微小错误也可能带来严重的临床后果。我们提出MedCode框架，通过训练大语言模型生成可执行的嵌入式代码来改进医学计算。给定临床情境，模型识别相关计算器，提取其输入变量，并生成脚本，将算术运算委托给确定性解释器执行。执行脚本返回计算值，并附带解释和适当的单位。我们从MedCalc基准构建了监督微调（SFT）和偏好数据集，并额外整理了一个用于重症监护室（ICU）场景的计算任务数据集。我们进一步提出加权直接偏好优化（wDPO），自适应地强调模型难以区分的偏好对。使用LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B进行的实验显示，绝对准确率提升了20至30个百分点，证明了嵌入式代码生成在医学计算中的有效性。

title: Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition
summary: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.
tldr: Nutri-ATLAS is an embodied nutrition assistant that combines USDA/FoodKG knowledge graph embeddings (GATv2), hybrid graph-text retrieval, LLM-based planning, and robot navigation to acquire food availability evidence and support nutrient estimation, substitution, and meal recommendations.
tldr_zh: Nutri-ATLAS 是一个具身营养助手，融合 USDA/FoodKG 知识图谱嵌入（GATv2）、混合图-文本检索、LLM 规划与机器人导航，以获取食物可得性证据并支持营养估计、替代品推荐和膳食推荐。
summary_zh: 生成式与具身智能物联网系统为数字健康应用提供了有前景的基础，这类应用将感知、个性化推理和自主交互相结合，部署于真实世界环境中。营养辅助是一个自然的用例，但现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统往往局限于被动的文本交互和静态上下文，在食物描述模糊或缺乏营养证据时可靠性不足。我们提出Nutri-ATLAS，一种用于表格化查询与辅助的具身智能体，旨在实现真实世界中更智能的营养管理。它融合了基于图的营养推理、硬件感知的LLM选型以及基于机器人的证据获取。Nutri-ATLAS从USDA FoodData Central和FoodKG构建统一的食物-营养素知识图谱，并学习64维GATv2食物和食谱嵌入。一种共享的混合图-文本评分机制支持食物营养提取、营养缺口填补、替代品检索和食谱级膳食构成，而LLM引导的技能接口可导航地标、更新饮食情境和食物可及性记忆，并将推荐建立在观察到的食物可用性之上。我们在营养素估计、替代品检索、食谱推荐、患者档案遵循性、边缘部署和真实世界具身执行等方面评估Nutri-ATLAS。在HealthyFoodSubs上，混合检索器达到37.9%的MAP、80.7%的RR@5和90.1%的RR@10。在NutriBench v2上，Dense+GAT检索在九种量化Qwen3.5-9B配置下为营养素估计提供了基础。在PFoodReQ上，Nutri-ATLAS达到78.8%的MAP、83.0%的MAR和77.5%的F1。一项患者档案研究显示，所有选定病例均符合过敏和健康目标约束。

title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
summary: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.
tldr: CLAIRE is a schema-grounded hybrid workflow for automating healthcare administrative form completion, combining LLM-based source-to-field mapping with deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. In synthetic benchmarks it achieved perfect episode success and large estimated time savings, while validation-stress cases degraded without the validation stage.
tldr_zh: CLAIRE 是一种基于模式（schema）驱动的混合工作流，用于自动化医疗行政表单填写，将基于大语言模型的源到字段映射与确定性校验、受限纠错、升级处理和审计追踪相结合。在合成基准测试中，它达到了完美的任务成功率，并显著节省预估时间；但若缺少校验阶段，在压力测试下的成功率会明显下降。
summary_zh:
摘要：
医疗行政人员将来自电子健康记录、转诊、索赔系统、提供者名册和工作队列的结构化信息转移到动态表单中。我们开发并评估了CLAIRE（用于推理和录入的临床语言与智能体智能），这是一种混合工作流，将字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、有界纠正、升级和审计追踪相分离。我们测试了五个合成医疗行政模式、1,000条源记录、四种界面变体、两套数据质量套件和六个比较器，生成了24,000个基准场景。一项独立的严格输出审计评估了来自Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B的直接映射，另有一项基于痕迹的操作模拟覆盖了6,000个场景。在所评估的合成基准条件下，完整版CLAIRE在两套套件中均达到了1.000的场景成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率和依赖关系完成率；移除验证后，压力套件成功率降至0.500。在模拟中，100.0%的干净场景和验证压力场景达到了可工作人员审阅的草稿，而升级挑战场景中这一比例为68.6%，不支持的情况则被阻止。基于场景的节省为每例149.7至165.5秒，而非观察到的员工时间。研究结果支持以模式为基础、验证优先的医疗行政自动化，其中语言模型组件辅助映射，但不会授权不支持或具有后果性的操作。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.
tldr: Proposes a reinforcement learning framework for chest X-ray report generation that verifies both reasoning steps (via anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and regional text descriptions) and final outputs using spatial and factual rewards; starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, SFT plus cold-start reasoning plus RL improves performance over SFT alone and reveals reward hacking modes.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于胸部X光报告生成的强化学习框架，通过解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述验证推理过程，并结合空间与事实奖励；以Qwen3-VL-8B为基础，采用SFT+冷启动推理+RL，相比单独SFT获得额外性能提升，并揭示了多种奖励黑客模式。
summary_zh: 医学报告生成随着现代视觉-语言模型的兴起和大规模医学数据集的日益丰富而取得了显著进展。然而，幻觉仍然是一个主要挑战，这在很大程度上源于监督微调（SFT）的局限性——它优先考虑与参考报告的词汇相似性，而非临床正确性。尽管强化学习在数学和代码生成等具有可验证奖励的领域表现出色，但其在开放式医学任务中的应用仍然有限。现有工作侧重于评估最终答案，忽视了模型的推理过程，尽管有证据表明有缺陷的推理会降低整体性能。在本研究中，我们提出了一种通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程的框架。我们设计了空间和事实奖励机制，以确保模型的推理既具有视觉基础又具有事实准确性。以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct作为基础模型，我们通过监督微调使其适应医学领域，通过冷启动SFT阶段引入推理能力，并使用强化学习对其进行优化。我们发现，强化学习带来的性能提升超过了仅使用SFT所能达到的效果，并且同时验证推理步骤和最终输出比单独验证其中任一者能带来更大的改进。我们进一步识别了强化学习阶段中多种奖励黑客模式。最后，模型的结构化思维轨迹增强了可解释性，使其输出更易于在临床使用中进行审计。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
summary: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.
tldr: Introduces World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that embeds SLAM-style incremental state updates and backend refinement directly into a navigation policy, jointly training future visual prediction, dense geometry estimation, and action generation.
tldr_zh: 提出世界 SLAM 模型（WSM），将 SLAM 的增量状态更新与后端优化机制融入导航策略，联合学习未来视觉预测、稠密几何与动作生成。
summary_zh: 我们介绍了世界SLAM模型（WSM），这是一个将SLAM范式直接引入下游导航的统一框架。WSM并非将SLAM仅视为提供位姿、地图或标记的上游模块，而是采用其核心机制，包括带持久记忆的增量状态更新以及累积误差的后端优化，在交互过程中维持一致的世界状态。给定当前观测和导航目标，WSM预测未来视觉状态，并联合估计其相机运动和稠密几何，将视觉预测置于一个不断演化的空间世界状态中。该空间状态随着新观测的到达而持续更新，并为动作生成和闭环导航提供基础。WSM以联合导航-SLAM目标进行端到端训练，使下游导航能够直接从SLAM式的状态维护与优化中受益，同时保持准确的几何估计。实验表明，WSM在提升导航性能的同时保持了强大的SLAM精度，凸显了SLAM作为长时程世界建模和具身交互内在机制的潜力。
